profile_md: Plymouth shows distributed, programme-level provision rather than an institution-wide scheme. The clearest route is the core 30-credit MBA module Leading Change, People and Projects: teams spend 10-14 weeks on a real organisational brief and present to the client organisation. Architecture runs live design-build projects for external clients (Dartington Hall Trust; a primary school) with student groups, though the page is undated. Photography (Year 1 core MEDI423) has teams tackle a live brief from a creative-industry client, and Creative Media has core external-partner modules, but deliverables are unspecified. Inspiring Futures, the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Business knowledge-exchange scheme, hosts named businesses and charities, but group versus individual routes cannot be separated. Business Management with Foundation Year BUSM3004 (team, real business or community project) and MEng PROJ500 (team prototype, problems from industry, commerce or research) lack evidence of an external organisation's role. Careers-run BOOST and Challenge Connect events could not be confirmed. Delivery years are mostly undated, so current status is unclear for most routes. No science, social science or health route was verified.
gaps: Most pages undated (only BUSM3004 corroborated by 2026-27 fee tables); module handbooks and assessment details not opened; BOOST/Challenge Connect, Year 2 Business Challenge, STO6005, STO312 (partner-delivered) unverified; further departmental instances likely (design, media, engineering, nursing/health); reduced-depth mode with about 10 searches plus page fetches.
